headline: RAG from Scratch: Grounding LLMs in Your Data
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) revolutionizes LLM accuracy by fetching external, relevant data. This approach combats hallucinations, ensuring LLMs deliver precise, up-to-date answers for critical engineering applications.

slides.title: LLMs Lie. How Do You Fix It?
slides.subtitle: Build RAG from scratch to ground LLMs in YOUR data.
slides.body: Generative AI models often "hallucinate" or lack current, domain-specific knowledge. This leads to inaccurate or irrelevant responses.
slides.deep_dive: Relying solely on a base LLM's pre-trained data creates a significant bottleneck for enterprise applications needing up-to-date, proprietary information. It's a key engineering challenge to ensure factual accuracy and domain relevance for LLM outputs.
slides.key_fact: RAG combines LLM power with external, factual data.
slides.why_it_matters: Ensures LLMs provide trustworthy, relevant answers.

slides.title: RAG: Your LLM's Smart Research Assistant
slides.body: Imagine your LLM needing to answer a complex question. Instead of guessing, RAG sends it to a "research assistant" first.

steps.title: Retrieve Context
steps.desc: RAG's assistant finds relevant notes from a huge library of your data.

steps.title: Augment & Generate
steps.desc: LLM gets the notes along with the query, then crafts a precise answer.

slides.title: The Data Prep Powerhouse: Chunking & Embeddings
slides.body: Raw documents are processed: chunked into smaller pieces, then converted into semantic numerical vectors (embeddings).
slides.input: Raw Documents (PDFs, internal knowledge base, web content)
slides.processing: 1. Chunking: Large documents broken into digestible, meaningful segments. 2. Embedding: Each chunk transformed into a numerical vector (embedding) by an embedding model, capturing its semantic meaning.
slides.output: Vector Database (populated with embedded chunks, ready for fast semantic search)

slides.title: Vector Database: Speed vs. Freshness
slides.body: Building a performant RAG system involves trade-offs between data freshness, retrieval speed, and the accuracy of retrieved context.
left_items: Indexing Speed: Embedding new data can be slow, impacting data freshness.
Retrieval Latency: Larger databases or complex queries increase lookup time.
Scalability: Managing high concurrent queries requires robust infrastructure.
right_items: Embeddings Quality: Better embedding models boost relevance but may cost more.
Chunk Size: Too small, context is lost; too large, introduces irrelevant noise.
Database Choice: Specialized vector DBs offer performance but add complexity.

slides.title: Naive Context Injection Kills Performance
slides.body: Simply dumping all retrieved data into an LLM prompt can overwhelm it and degrade answer quality. Optimization is key.
before_items: Dump all retrieved chunks directly into the LLM prompt.
Ignore LLM token limits or context window constraints.
No relevance scoring or re-ranking of retrieved data.
after_items: Re-ranking: Use a secondary model to re-score and filter chunks.
Summarization: Condense relevant chunks to fit token limits.
Adaptive Chunking: Dynamically adjust chunk size based on query complexity.

slides.title: RAG in High-Throughput Systems
slides.body: For systems with millions of queries, RAG components must scale independently. Caching and distributed processing are crucial.
slides.deep_dive: High-throughput RAG systems employ distributed indexing to break down embedding jobs, multi-tenant vector databases for isolated data and scalable access, and query caching to reduce redundant vector lookups. Asynchronous processing handles context generation separately from LLM inference, ensuring responsiveness.
slides.key_fact: Scalable RAG ensures low latency and high accuracy even under heavy load.
slides.why_it_matters: Enables real-time, personalized AI experiences in demanding environments.

slides.title: RAG: Your Blueprint for Grounded LLMs
slides.body: RAG is essential for reliable LLM applications. Master its core components for robust, context-aware AI solutions.
takeaways: Enhance LLM Accuracy: Combat hallucinations by providing real-time, relevant external data.
Tailor to Domains: Easily adapt LLMs to specific industries or proprietary knowledge bases.
Optimize Retrieval: Focus on chunking strategies, embedding quality, and vector DB performance.
